title: CAD Exporter system design
summary: A polling worker that claims CAD or mesh export jobs, executes the matching model path, upserts artifacts, and records a terminal generation-job status.

nodes.label: Generation Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres generation_jobs rows for export_cad and export_mesh work and terminal status.

details.responsibility: Own queued, running, completed, failed, and cancelled export-job lifecycle state.

inputs.name: export job
inputs.description: A project, part, type, and optional source_sha256 for export_cad.

outputs.name: claimed row
outputs.description: The oldest queued supported row after it is changed to running.

outputs.name: terminal status
outputs.description: Completed, failed with bounded error_message, or cancelled with source_superseded result.

durableReads: Oldest queued export_cad or export_mesh row selected with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
durableWrites: cancelled status, error_message, and source_superseded result

nodes.label: 1. Job Claim
nodes.description: Polls for and atomically claims the next queued export_cad or export_mesh row.

details.responsibility: Ask Postgres for one supported export job and dispatch a returned row to source staging.
trigger: The process polls continuously; an empty result sleeps for two seconds.
preconditions: SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are present when the process starts.

outputs.name: claimed job
outputs.description: A generation_jobs row already marked running, or no row.

steps: Call claim_next_supported_generation_job for export_cad and export_mesh.
Continue to Source Staging when a row is returned.
Sleep for two seconds when no row is returned.

failureConditions.outcome: No handoff occurs; the process sleeps and polls again.
The exception is outside the per-job try block and terminates the process.

operations.concurrency: One export job at a time per worker process.
operations.retry: Empty polls repeat. Claim exceptions are not caught by the worker loop.
observability: Per-job cancellation and failure tracebacks are written to stderr.
controls: The empty-poll delay is fixed at two seconds.

nodes.label: 2. Source Staging
nodes.description: Downloads the matching part model.py and params.json into an ephemeral job-local workspace.

details.responsibility: Create the clean job workspace and stage source from the CAD or mesh namespace selected by job type.
trigger: A supported generation job has been claimed.

inputs.name: claimed job
inputs.description: Job id, project_id, part_id, type, and optional source_sha256.

steps: Remove any pre-existing /tmp/jobs/<job-id> directory.
Select the CAD or mesh source prefix from the job type.
Download model.py and params.json into the job-local source directory.
Remove the entire job-local workspace in a finally block.
guarantees: The job-local workspace is removed after successful, failed, or cancelled processing.

nodes.label: Part Source Storage
nodes.description: Accepted CAD or mesh source objects in the private 3dProjects bucket.

details.responsibility: Durably own the current CAD and mesh model source and parameters read by the exporter.
downstream: Source Staging is the reader in this service.

nodes.label: 3A. CAD Revision Guard
nodes.description: For export_cad only, compares model.py with source_sha256 when the job supplies one.

details.responsibility: Prevent a hash-bound CAD job from exporting model.py bytes that changed after the job was created.
trigger: Source Staging completes for an export_cad job.
preconditions: The guard enforces a comparison only when source_sha256 is not null.

outputs.name: permitted CAD source
outputs.description: The staged files continue to CadQuery execution when no hash was supplied or the hash matches.

decisionPoints: No expected hash skips the comparison; a supplied hash must match exactly.
details.shortCircuit: A mismatch raises SupersededJob before model import, artifact generation, or upload.
details.successCondition: source_sha256 is absent or equals the SHA-256 of staged model.py.

failureConditions.outcome: The job is cancelled with reason source_superseded; existing stored exports are not deleted.

nodes.label: 3B. CadQuery Export
nodes.description: Executes accepted CAD source inside the worker process and exports STEP and STL locally.

details.responsibility: Import CAD model.py, construct ModelParams, call build_model, export STEP/STL, and upload both files.
trigger: An export_cad job passes or skips the optional CAD Revision Guard.
preconditions: params.json must decode to a JSON object.
steps: Import model.py in the worker process.
Decode params.json and construct ModelParams.
Call build_model(params).
Run CadQuery exporters for STEP and STL.
Upsert model.step, then upsert model.stl.

failureConditions.condition: Import, parameter construction, build, export, or upload raises
failureConditions.outcome: The job is marked failed with the first 4,000 traceback characters. An earlier successful upload is not rolled back.

operations.concurrency: Runs inline; one job at a time per worker process.
observability: Failures log the full traceback to stderr and persist its first 4,000 characters.
controls: This path has no configured execution timeout.

nodes.label: 3C. Blender Runtime
nodes.description: Executes mesh source in a background Blender subprocess with a sanitized environment and timeout.

details.responsibility: Prepare a clean Blender scene, execute the mesh model contract, and export local STL and GLB files.
trigger: Source Staging completes for an export_mesh job.
preconditions: The configured Blender executable is present.

outputs.name: local STL and GLB
outputs.description: Artifacts from the selected returned Blender objects.

steps: Start Blender in background factory-startup mode.
Remove known credentials plus *_TOKEN and *_SECRET variables and set job-local HOME/TMPDIR.
Reset objects and collections and configure metric millimeter display.
Import model.py, construct ModelParams, and call build_model.
Require a non-empty list of registered exportable Blender objects, including traversed children.
Export selected objects to STL and GLB.
details.successCondition: Blender exits zero after both exporter operations report FINISHED.

failureConditions.condition: Blender is missing, times out, exits non-zero, or rejects the model contract
failureConditions.outcome: The job is marked failed and no mesh artifact upload is attempted.

operations.timeout: 300 seconds by default; BLENDER_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer.
operations.concurrency: One Blender subprocess at a time per worker process.
observability: On timeout or non-zero exit, the raised error includes at most the last 8,000 characters of combined subprocess output.

nodes.label: 3D. Mesh Artifact Checks
nodes.description: Validates local STL/GLB presence and STL geometry before sequential storage uploads.

details.responsibility: Reject empty or structurally invalid mesh output before either mesh artifact is published.

inputs.name: model.stl
inputs.description: Local STL output loaded with trimesh.

inputs.name: model.glb
inputs.description: Local GLB output checked for presence and non-zero size.

outputs.name: verified mesh artifacts
outputs.description: Local STL and GLB eligible for sequential upsert.

steps: Require non-empty STL and GLB files.
Require STL vertices and faces.
Require finite vertices and bounds.
Require meaningful extent in at least two dimensions.
Require at least one finite, non-degenerate face.
Upsert model.stl, then upsert model.glb.
details.shortCircuit: Any validation failure prevents both upload calls.

failureConditions.outcome: The job is marked failed and neither generated mesh file is uploaded.
The job is marked failed; an earlier successful STL upsert is not rolled back.

nodes.label: Export Storage
nodes.description: Shared exports/<part_id> objects upserted sequentially by successful CAD or verified mesh paths.

details.responsibility: Durably own the latest successfully upserted export objects for a project part.

operations.retry: No upload retry or multi-file rollback is implemented.
observability: Storage exceptions fail the active generation job.

nodes.label: 4. Job Completion
nodes.description: Writes completed, failed, or source-superseded cancellation state to generation_jobs.

details.responsibility: Translate the export routine outcome into the terminal generation_jobs update.
trigger: run_export_job returns, raises SupersededJob, or raises another exception.

inputs.name: successful return
inputs.description: Both path-specific upload calls returned without raising.

inputs.name: SupersededJob
inputs.description: A supplied CAD source hash did not match.

inputs.name: other exception
inputs.description: A source, execution, validation, export, or storage operation failed.

outputs.name: completed
outputs.description: Only status is set to completed.

outputs.name: cancelled
outputs.description: Status, message, and schema-v1 source_superseded result are written.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Status and the first 4,000 traceback characters are written.

durableWrites: generation_jobs terminal status, plus cancellation result or failure error_message where applicable
decisionPoints: SupersededJob is handled separately from all other exceptions.
details.successCondition: The selected export routine and both sequential storage uploads return without raising.

failureConditions.condition: The terminal database update itself raises
failureConditions.outcome: The exception is not caught by another recovery layer.

details.summary: Job Claim initiates an atomic Postgres selection and queued-to-running update for the oldest supported row. There is no worker lease or database-initiated request.
details.payload: The fixed export_cad and export_mesh type list.
details.durability: A returned row is already marked running.
details.failureBehavior: No row causes a two-second sleep. A claim exception terminates the process.

details.summary: A returned supported generation_jobs row is dispatched immediately in the same worker process.
preconditions: The claim RPC returned a row.
details.durability: Transient in-process handoff; the job row is durable in Postgres.
details.failureBehavior: No row means the handoff does not occur.

details.summary: Source Staging initiates reads from the CAD or mesh part prefix selected by the claimed job type.
preconditions: The job type is export_cad or export_mesh.
details.durability: Storage remains the durable owner; local copies are deleted with the job workspace.
details.failureBehavior: A download failure marks the generation job failed.

details.summary: Only the CAD path applies the optional source revision comparison before project code executes.
details.payload: Staged CAD model.py and optional source_sha256.
details.failureBehavior: A supplied mismatching hash cancels the job and prevents CAD execution and upload.

details.summary: CAD execution begins when no source hash was supplied or the downloaded model.py matches the supplied hash.
preconditions: source_sha256 is absent or matches model.py.
details.trustBoundary: Project model.py executes in the main worker process, which was created with Supabase service-role configuration.

details.summary: Mesh source and parameters are passed to a sanitized Blender subprocess. This path does not call verify_source_hash.
details.failureBehavior: A missing executable, timeout, or non-zero exit marks the job failed.
details.trustBoundary: Project code crosses into the Blender subprocess after known credentials and token/secret-suffixed variables are removed.

details.summary: CadQuery Export initiates two independent storage upserts after both local exports are produced.
preconditions: CadQuery import, model build, and both local exporter calls returned.
details.durability: Each successful call replaces or creates its object immediately; the pair is not transactional.
details.failureBehavior: If STEP succeeds and STL fails, STEP can remain updated while the job is marked failed.

details.summary: The CAD path reaches successful completion only after both storage upload calls return without raising.
preconditions: STEP and STL upserts both returned.
details.payload: Successful function return; no artifact manifest is persisted on the job.
details.durability: Transient control handoff before the terminal database update.
details.failureBehavior: Any path exception is handled as failed, except SupersededJob which is cancelled.

details.summary: A zero-exit Blender process hands its local files to mesh validation before any mesh upload.
preconditions: Blender returned exit code zero after both exporters reported FINISHED.
details.durability: Transient local files deleted with the job workspace.
details.failureBehavior: A failed mesh check prevents both upload calls.

details.summary: Mesh Artifact Checks initiates two independent upserts only after both files and STL geometry pass validation.
preconditions: Both files are non-empty and the STL passes structural, finite-geometry, extent, and face-area checks.
details.durability: Each successful call commits its object independently; the pair is not transactional.
details.failureBehavior: If STL succeeds and GLB fails, STL can remain updated while the job is marked failed.

details.summary: The mesh path reaches successful completion only after validation and both storage upserts return.
preconditions: Mesh checks and both STL/GLB uploads returned.
details.payload: Successful function return; no artifact manifest is persisted on the job.
details.durability: Transient control handoff before the terminal database update.
details.failureBehavior: Any validation or upload exception is handled as a failed job.

details.summary: Job Completion initiates the terminal generation_jobs update after classifying the export outcome.
details.payload: Completed writes status only; failed adds bounded error_message; cancelled adds message and source_superseded result.
details.durability: The update is the durable lifecycle outcome. It does not provide transactional coupling to prior object uploads.
details.failureBehavior: A terminal update exception is not caught by a second recovery layer.

boundaries.label: CAD Exporter Worker
boundaries.description: One polling process owns claim, staging, both execution paths, artifact validation, publication, and terminal status.

boundaries.label: Sanitized Blender subprocess
boundaries.description: Only the mesh path executes project code in this bounded subprocess.
